newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-Nov fiscal revenues up 18.1 pct -Xinhua.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-Nov fiscal revenues up 18.1 pct -Xinhua.

text.p: China's January-November fiscal revenues rose 18.1 percent from the same 1995 period, outpacing spending which grew 17.4 percent, Xinhua news agency said on Wednesday.

China would gradually introduce a mechanism to curb excessive growth in fiscal expenditure to ensure that budget targets would not be missed, the official agency quoted Minister of Finance Liu Zhongli as saying.
It gave no details of the proposed mechanism.
"To curb the rapid expansion of expenses and readjust our expenditure structure, we must practice thrift and fight against waste," it quoted Liu as saying.
Public expenses should be reined in and the purchasing power of institutions strictly controlled, Xinhua quoted him as saying but did not elaborate.
